authoritativePatronIdentity.name: Fiend Patron
authoritativePatronIdentity.sourceNote: 2014 subclass chooses Fiend at level 1; 2024 source describes subclass at level 3. Native Patron identity still begins at level 1; the timing of granted powers is separate.

parts.name: Fiend Spell Access
parts.common: Patron alters spells available to the Warlock.
differences: 2014 adds spell choices to the Warlock spell list without automatically granting them; 2024 grants specified spells via always-prepared terminology, requiring the approved native no-daily-preparation conversion.
The two spell lists are not identical.
2014 source feature appears at Warlock 1; 2024 at Warlock 3.

parts.name: Dark One's Blessing
parts.common: Temporary Hit Points equal to Charisma modifier plus Warlock class level, minimum 1, when a qualifying enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
differences: 2014: Warlock personally reduces a hostile creature to 0 HP.
2024: also triggers when another creature reduces an enemy within 10 feet of the Warlock to 0 HP.

parts.name: Dark One's Own Luck
parts.common: At Warlock level 6, add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after the roll and before its effects.
differences: 2014: one use, restored after Short or Long Rest.
2024: Charisma modifier uses (minimum one), no more than once per roll; all uses restored after Long Rest.

parts.name: Fiendish Resilience (Fiend Patron)
parts.common: At Warlock level 10, select a damage type at the end of a Short or Long Rest and gain Resistance until changed on a later rest.
differences: 2014: magical or silvered weapon damage ignores this Resistance, no force-damage exclusion is stated.
2024: cannot select Force damage; no magical/silvered weapon bypass is stated.
Distinct from previously approved historical Warlock BASE CLASS fast healing; the owner has reopened that base-class grant for review. The Patron resistance feature remains independent.

parts.name: Hurl Through Hell
parts.common: At Warlock level 14, on a qualifying attack hit, send a creature through the Lower Planes and return it at the end of the next turn; damage is Psychic for non-Fiends.
differences: 2014: no saving throw, deals 10d10 damage on return, once per Long Rest.
2024: Charisma saving throw negates the effect; on a failure deals 8d10 on application and Incapacitates until return; once per Long Rest, but expending a Pact Magic slot can restore a use.
The native ruling must resolve saving throw, damage timing/dice, status, and slot-spending recovery together.

openNativeDecisions.question: Which Fiend powers, if any, begin at Warlock level 1 in the authoritative native progression (beyond identity)?
openNativeDecisions.resolution: Use the 2014 Fiend level-1 mechanical milestone: Dark One's Blessing and Patron spell access accompany Fiend Patron selection at class level 1. The spell access grant's exact automatic-versus-selectable behavior and spell list remain unresolved. Preserve both source-era projections for provenance.

openNativeDecisions.question: Which source spell lists and spell-access grants are unified, and what native entitlement replaces source always-prepared versus expanded-choice rules?
At the established native level-1 grant, adopt the 2014 self-defeat trigger or 2024 expanded nearby-other-creature trigger?

Recovery cadence remains open: 2024 Long Rest refill is recommended; 2014 used a single use restored after Short/Long Rest. Do not silently treat Charisma modifier uses as recharging on every Short Rest.
openNativeDecisions.approved: Number of uses equal to the Warlock's Charisma modifier, minimum 1; the same one-per-roll limit and post-roll timing from SRD 5.2.1.

openNativeDecisions.question: Select force eligibility and magical/silvered damage bypass rules?
Resolve save, 10d10 versus 8d10, damage timing, Incapacitated, and Pact-slot recovery.

Should the previously approved 3.5e BASE-CLASS Fiendish Resilience fast healing at class levels 8/13/18 remain as an automatic Warlock grant, become an optional Invocation, or be retired after reviewing 5.x defensive features? No replacement was approved; other historical base-class rulings remain in place.
How much interchange among different Patrons is permitted and costed? Real multi-Patron validation deferred because only Fiend is in the SRDs.

explicitExclusions: Activating unreconciled mechanics as native rules

patronInitialFiendMilestone.qualification: Only acquisition timing and part identity are approved; spell grant semantics and Dark One's Blessing trigger remain undecided.

luckUses.qualification: Uses are approved, 2024 Long Rest recovery is a recommendation, not yet owner-approved.
